snippet.title: LIFTED | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist at https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184020?utm_source=announcement_trailer

Get LIFTED! Play as slacker Ari, unwillingly starring in his professor’s deeply personal, HILARIOUS era-hopping tiara heist. Swing, climb, puzzle through time & outsmart a rival tomb-raider – an ’80s blockbuster adventure!
